purpose: Persistent plans for autonomous street rhythm: recognizable block composition rather than individually exact facade reconstruction. Technical validity and visual acceptance are separate.
lessons: Palette accuracy cannot compensate for a wrong facade assembly. Balcony stacks, vertical bays and subdivided windows carry identity.
Independent probabilities for details lose architectural relationships. Generate supported joint assemblies aligned to openings and floor axes.
Three improvement cycles are effort history, not an acceptance threshold. Continue when a defining feature remains missing.
Heldouts are attempts to falsify transfer. A visibly failed heldout prevents expanding that family; it cannot be excused by a successful training view.
A passing source audit, test suite or performance check does not establish architectural resemblance.
Acceptance requires evidence against prewritten source-derived criteria, including the worst reviewed view. Report failures as prominently as successes.
Do not chase exact facade registration. Compare relationships, proportions and street composition with comparable orientation and scale, documenting camera shifts.

Calibrate source-observed group counts against the actual chosen layout nominal bay width. A bayScale multiplier without that conversion can turn two visual modules into nine repeated panes; compare rendered group spacing, not preset names.

Construction year is a factual input, not reliable visual-period evidence for retained or rebuilt historic fronts. Independent station views can justify a locally observed frontage class; width alone cannot identify it.
Test actual native neighbor geometry and dispatch budgets: isolated assembly tests passed while another wall starved the defining facade.

A building-wide ornament cap is a safety limit, not a fidelity target. Prioritize architectural relationships and evaluate near-detail budgets with actual LOD ownership, visual contradictions and full-scene GPU measurements.

User steering2026-10-04: rhythm, not perfection. Prioritize distributions and relationships across a street row—frontage widths, white trim, window groups, roof families and balcony frequency. Exact corner wrapping or photo registration is secondary unless its absence changes the overall street character.
Official address-to-Pand monument descriptions corrected legacy crown assignments. Use explicit source identities for known crown families; use joint row priors for unsourced neighbors.
Final native geometry and camera projections expose approximate roof closures that unit roof bounds cannot catch. Review the actual whole-row mesh before acceptance.

A heldout can expose a shared roof-fitting defect independently of recipe inference. Repair geometry across families, retain the failed challenge, and require a fresh challenge before admitting new style transfer.
Short visible returns belong to the row grammar: inherit coherent masonry and one quiet window column; blank fins and unrelated stock shop templates both break continuity.
Window groups and doors must share the same physical axes as stairs/rails. A step leading to generic glass is not a completed entrance assembly.
